functions.name: Frame_WaitForVBlankAndDelay11
functions.body: Saves the incoming D0 word, calls Frame_WaitForVBlankWork, loads D0 with 10, executes the NOP at 0x001B32BE eleven times with DBF, restores the original D0, and returns.
functions.effect: Adds one VBlank synchronization followed by an exact eleven-iteration delay while preserving D0.

functions.name: SceneResource_ClearScratchWords
functions.body: Loads A0 with 0x00FFF17A, loads D4 with 0x01BF, clears the word at (A0)+, and repeats through DBF for 448 words before returning.
functions.effect: Clears the fixed 896-byte scene-resource scratch block beginning at 0x00FFF17A.

functions.name: Terrain_WriteMapWordAtOffset
functions.body: Loads A0 with TERRAIN_ROW_POINTER_TABLE at 0x00FF9884, selects the row pointer at D1.w, adds D0.w to that row address, stores D2.w at the resulting map location, and returns.
functions.effect: Writes one word into a selected runtime terrain row at a caller-provided signed byte offset.

limitations: No direct static caller was exported for the three entries, so their local register/address contracts are recorded without assigning a scene, menu, or terrain gameplay path.
The write helper's caller-supplied row and byte offset semantics are exact from the instruction sequence; the higher-level reason for mutating the terrain buffer remains unresolved.
conclusion: Three complete utility bodies in the scene/terrain service region are now bounded and named by their exact synchronization, scratch-clear, and row-pointer write contracts.
